description: This file exports a Python source code string that provides file system manipulation functions for sandboxed environments. It includes operations such as opening directories, walking parent directories, creating temporary files, running commands, writing stdin to files, and performing file system modifications like write, mkdirp, remove, and rename, all within a controlled sandbox context.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Opens a directory at the specified path with predefined flags.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Traverses up the directory hierarchy, optionally creating directories if enabled.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a uniquely named temporary file within a parent directory.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Constructs a filesystem path from a file descriptor and optional basename.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments, passing specified file descriptors.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Reads data from stdin and writes it to a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Handles the write operation: walks to the parent, creates temp file, writes data, and replaces original.

methods.name: run_mkdirp
methods.description: Creates directories via walking to parent and executing mkdirp command.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Removes files or directories, with options for recursive and force removal.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Renames or moves files between directories.
